### The Ark of the Covenant Captured
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/ark-of-the-covenant-captured
Passage: 1 Samuel 4:3
Points:
- Israel correctly recognized that God stood behind their initial military defeat against the Philistines.
- Rather than repenting of their sins, the leaders wrongly treated the ark as a magic token to force God's favor.
- God had granted victory alongside the ark in Joshua's day, but He does not bless flagrant covenant disobedience.
- External religious practices and church involvement are meaningless without genuine inward faith in Christ.

### Day 8: 1 Samuel 4:1–11
Author: Beth Moore
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/plus/books/portraits-of-devotion/portraits-of-devotion-day-8-1-samuel-4-111.html
Passage: 1 Samuel 4:5
Points:
- People who practice outward religion without truly walking with God frequently confuse genuine faith with superstition.
- Presuming upon God, Israel attempted to use the ark like a good-luck charm rather than honoring Him.
- Because corrupt priests accompanied the ark, God refused to honor their neglect or grant them victory.
- Religious symbols and sacred objects hold no saving power apart from the presence of God Himself.
